name: Better Pets Hospital
addressFull: 263/120-121 Soi Chai Rerk 2, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

pricing.boardingPerNight: Dogs: THB 300-500/day depending on weight/room; cats: THB 300-700/day depending on room. Food is excluded; special care is an additional THB 300/day.

emergency.notes: No reliable public confirmation of emergency intake or after-hours service was found.

petTravel.notes: The hospital's service page confirms microchipping and rabies titre testing for international travel. It does not identify the microchip as ISO 11784/11785, name the titre laboratory, publish an export-health-certificate service, or state that it handles DLD export paperwork.

complaints: one recent snippet criticized staff communication
